request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: For positive integers A, B, C, x, y, z with A^x + B^y = C^z and x, y, z >= 3, then gcd(A, B, C) > 1. Strictly requires x,y,z >= 3 (strictly hyperbolic defect 1/x + 1/y + 1/z - 1 <= -1/12). Primitive solutions (gcd(A,B,C)=1) must be non-existent.
request_state.title: C009
request_state.claim: No counterexample to Beal's conjecture exists with A, B <= 160000 and exponents x, y, z in {3,5,7,11,13,17,19}.
request_state.method: Exhaustive multi-threaded GMP search over coprime base pairs with arbitrary-precision verification.

- Failure Mode 1 (Residual conflation): Concluding a mod-p congruence is impossible purely from non-isogeny, l-adic isomorphism refutation, or endomorphism algebra inequality. (FALLACY)
- Sound Modular Sieve (Kraus criterion): Explicitly computing local Frobenius traces a_k(E) mod l and proving a_k(E) != a_k(f) mod l for all newforms f at auxiliary prime k = 2mp+1. This directly eliminates the residual mod-p congruence itself and is COMPLETELY SOUND (sound_no_failure_mode).

- Failure Mode 5 (Local-Global Moduli Conflation): Invariant depends only on the projective cross-ratio t = A/B in P^1(Q) or P^1(C), completely blind to integer coprimality gcd(gcd(A,B),C) > 1.

survey_category.instructions:
Classify the mathematical mechanism according to the repository Survey-of-Failures gate (U211):
- fatal_bounded_sieve: Bounded / fixed-input computation, congruence or covering sieves (can never resolve Beal).
- fatal_modular_single_sig: Modular method one signature at a time (stalls: no Frey object for 3 independent exponents).
- fatal_elementary: Elementary methods (LTE, p-adic valuations, difference-of-powers, residues - invalid or FC-blind).
- fatal_abc_baker: ABC or Baker linear forms in logarithms (ineffective or too weak with unknown bases).
- live_unifying_modular_motivic: Unifying modular/motivic object for three exponents (LIVE direction).
- live_effective_diophantine_geometry: Effective Diophantine geometry bounding coordinates (LIVE direction).
